factor_dict.ANOM_BETA2:

factor_dict.ANOM_DOWNSIDE_VOL:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
dr = ret.where(ret < 0, 0)
out = dr.rolling(252).std()
factor_dict.ANOM_SKEW:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = ret.rolling(60).skew()
factor_dict.ANOM_KURT:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = ret.rolling(60).kurt()
factor_dict.ANOM_IDIOSKEW:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
mkt = get_stock_index('000001', 'close').pct_change()
beta = rolling_regbeta(ret, mkt, 252)
resid = ret - beta * mkt
out = resid.rolling(60).skew()
